claim: For an actual coordinate carrier H, the reserve cost of an arbitrary signed addition is controlled by the spectrum of the positive part of the decrease in the compressed square Gram matrix.
A further dense tail of operator norm delta is charged only by deterministic singular-value perturbation.

A 16-dimensional exact-target family with a full-rank unbounded signed packet, an arbitrary-magnitude rank-two destructive-defect addition, and a dense tail of norm at most 1/4 has density less than 577.
